description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component, verifying markdown preprocessing functionalities such as image extraction, metadata stripping, and text normalization.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A structure containing multiple test cases for verifying the behavior of ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extracting embedded data URL images from markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests handling remote markdown images and flattening them into text.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Verifies fallback behavior when remote images have no label.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Tests processing of unicode characters placed before remote images.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Ensures that inbound untrusted context JSON blocks are correctly stripped.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Verifies removal of a single conversation info block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Checks multiple known inbound metadata sentinel lines are properly stripped.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures that JSON fences not marked as metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsLeadingTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Tests removal of timestamp prefixes from markdown lines.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Verifies removal of envelope headers and message ID hints.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Checks that trailing untrusted context suffixes are removed.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Ensures that untrusted context headers are preserved if they contain user content.
